operations.title: The source-normalized physical Cut-nearby commutator has zero image in the elliptic width-two coinvariant
operations.body: Entry 226's nonzero commutator is supported on e3,e5,e6. Entry 150's infinity-Gysin map kills each component termwise, so the composite to the elliptic quotient and its Z/2 coinvariant is integrally zero. The commutator remains a third-Rees algebraic Tate/Kummer class; no new carrier datum appears.
